entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: They closed the roof off.[n]What do we do now?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: How are we gonna get some[n]privacy for our meetings now?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, we don't have any big[n]targets right now. And midterms[n]are coming up anyway.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Let's just put our meetups on hold for[n]now. They draw a ton of attention to us,[n]anyway.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Guess we don't have a choice...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: God, the school prez is[n]so annoying.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Quit complaining and just do it!
